slides.altText: Students: Complete your course evaluations, be entered to win a prize. Evaluations open Dec. 1 - 14. Check your email starting Nov. 28 for more information.

Join ET+I for Cookies, Ornaments, and Evals! Wednesday, December 10 from 11 a.m. to 2 p.m. in the Taubman 6th floor hub. Complete your student evaluations, then get a cookie and ornament to decorate for the EdTech tree!
